name: (🐷 SEASON 3 💸) Impossible Glass Bridge! ✨
desc:
Inspired by Squid Game!
Welcome to Impossible Glass Bridge!

Cross an unstable glass bridge with your friends, face the danger, and race to the finish line to compete for the grand prize! Use outfits and tools, choose your favorite character, and have fun customizing your avatar.

This challenge is not for the weak! Crossing alone is nearly impossible – only 1% manage to win on their first try, while 99% fail! Can you overcome the impossible? Good luck! 🎯🔥

💰 Join the group and multiply your money by 1.5x! 💰
